thread:
Maya Liu: tiny shoutout to Owen and Tess for swooping in on the midday demo glitch. Presenter never missed a beat. :sparkles: :raised_hands:

Owen Brooks: happy to help! I toggled the feature flag and cleared a bad cache. weird timing with the deploys but resolved. :gear:

Tess Gallagher: and I patched the docs so the next person won't hit the same rollback step by accident. filed a one-liner in runbook. :memo:

Maya Liu: sending virtual cookies to both of you — real cookies in the kitchen at 3pm for the team. please add your names to the jar note if you grab one. :cookie:

Carlos Ruiz: real cookies? count me in. also, big thanks to infra-bot alerts which pointed us to the suspect instance quickly.

infra-bot: alert #2142: cache_invalidation_failure detected on runner-11. Acknowledged by Owen Brooks. Mitigation: feature_flag_toggle. :white_check_mark:

Owen Brooks: follow-up: i'll run a short cron to sweep stale caches overnight. nothing fancy, just a safe TTL bump.

Tess Gallagher: pairing offer: i'll help verify the cron tomorrow at 10am if anyone wants to join. coffee on me. :coffee:

Maya Liu: love it. Adding a note for the weekly roundup: "Cookie Cart: kudos to Owen & Tess". Thanks team — small rescues = big morale. :sparkling_heart:
